title: lespedeza striata var. stipulacea
intro: Lespedeza striata var. stipulacea, commonly known as Japanese clover, is a perennial legume native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese clover include anti-anaphylactic and anti-histaminic effects, which can help alleviate allergic reactions and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Japanese clover include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
